query: Act as a reviewer for Nature Communications and review my manuscript on CRISPR off-target effects. Give me Critical, Major and Minor issues.
Can you check whether my methods and stats hold up? It's a mixed-effects model on 14 classrooms and I'm not sure the design supports the claims.
Run a panel review of my preprint on climate tipping points: one reviewer on methods, one on statistics, one on reproducibility.
Before I submit to ICML, critique the paper like reviewer 2 would. Are the baselines fair and can someone reproduce the experiments?
Check that the references in my manuscript exist and actually support what I cite them for.
Review my writing for clarity: passive voice, clutter, keyword consistency. Not the science.
I want an editorial review of my whole 12-chapter book on quantum computing with a publishability verdict.
